quote: N = 158 nonvoters, 275 Clinton voters, and 218 Trump voters.
reason: Primary source identity (Schaffner & Luks, 2018, doi:10.1093/poq/nfx042) and the first-condition crowd-photo accuracy comparison by 2016 vote choice (pp. 139-140, Figure 2) are confirmed. Summing the three mutually exclusive voter groups reported in the Figure 2 caption after excluding third-party voters (158 nonvoters + 275 Clinton voters + 218 Trump voters) yields N = 651, confirming both shipped and blind values.
